# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want OPNduck to be a friendly place to ask questions, report problems and share plugins, for everyone,
whatever their age, background, experience or the way they work. We pledge to treat each other with respect.

## What we expect

- Be kind and patient. Assume the other person is trying to help.
- Give feedback about the work, not the person. Criticism is welcome; insults are not.
- Say so when you do not understand something, and answer questions without making anyone feel small.
- Respect other people's time: one clear issue per report, and say what you already tried.
- Keep it safe for young people: many of the people here are teenagers. No harassment, no sexual content, no
  pressure to share personal information.

## What is not acceptable

- Harassment, threats, hate speech or slurs, in any form.
- Personal attacks, doxxing, or sharing someone's private information.
- Spam, advertising, or plugins that try to harm users (see the plugin rules in [PLUGINS.md](../PLUGINS.md)).
- Repeating the same demand after being told no.

## Where this applies

Issues, pull requests, discussions, comments and any other space run for the project, and when you speak for
the project in public.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit, hide or remove comments, close or lock threads, and block people who break these
rules. To report a problem, use GitHub's "Report content" on the comment, or open a private security advisory
on this repository (Security tab) if it is sensitive. Reports are handled privately and in good faith.
